title: Souls Immortality
description:
Immortality Plugin, which will not let you drop under 0.5 Hearts
Perfect for Scripted SMPs
body:
![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72f5e5bb3cfa3a9df3ca87ece633910c2966fe97.png) ![ ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/238c09f10ff1802f7d5c7a1f76b936c3c49aac61.png)

Souls Immortailty is a Plugin made for Scripted SMPs, as it grants you immortality if you have 0.5 Hearts.

### Features

- **Death Prevention** - Players who are immortal, cannot drop under 0.5 hearts
- **Totem usage** - A totem in your main-hand or off-hand, will still pop like normal
- **Server Restarts** - Immortal Players will be saved, on server restarts
- **Config** - You can change the minimum of hearts that immortal players can have


## The Plugin works pretty simple:

- /immortality activate - Activates immortality 
- /immortality deactivate - Deactivates immortality, duhh
- /immortality list - tells you how many players have immortality

Only Operators can use these commands. There is also a permission: immortality.admin
### More Commands soon
